non_blocking.suggestion: Line 62 says the 64 MiB and 30 s fetch limits (target) are 'proposed there for Nodes and the CLI', but Control plane and GitOps (Building and recording a Revision, line 236) sets them only for Ruralz Control's online Plugin check. L1 raises the same point. Suggested wording: 'inside the 64 MiB and 30 s fetch limits (target) that Control plane and GitOps sets for the online Plugin check, which this ADR applies to Nodes and the CLI'.

Line 30, 'P2 and P1, standalone and free', is an acceptable paraphrase. To match the canonical wording that P6, P9 and P10 now use, consider 'P2 and P1, the gateway stands alone and everything is free'.

Two supporting URLs, https://pkg.go.dev/oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote (option 1) and https://blog.sigstore.dev/rekor-v2-ga/ (Offline verification), are not in the manifest research file docs/_meta/research/tooling-and-licenses.md. Each option still cites at least one research URL, so this is not blocking. Consider also citing go-libraries-protocols.md, which holds the sigstore-go 'considered stable and ready for production use' quote, in More information.
